topics.text: In each of the following subjects, the topics have been divided into two categories – Core Topics and Special Topics
The corresponding sections of the question paper will contain at least 90% of the questions on Core Topics and the remaining 10% at most on Special Topics
Linear Algebra: Vector algebra, matrix algebra, systems of linear equations, rank of a matrix
Functions of single variable, limits, continuity and differentiability, chain rule, maxima and minima, Integration
Functions of several variables, partial derivatives, gradient, divergence and curl, directional derivatives
Theorems of Stokes, Gauss and Green
First order linear ordinary differential equations
Higher order linear ODEs with constant coefficients
solution to: wave equation, Laplace equation, heat equation using separation of variables methods
Numerical solutions for linear and nonlinear algebraic equations by bisection, Newton- Raphson method
numerical integration by trapezoidal and Simpson’s rules
linear regression and least squares method
complex numbers, analytic functions and Cauchy-Riemann equations
Airplane (fixed wing aircraft) configuration and various parts
Altimeter, air speed indicator, vertical speed indicator, turn-bank indicator
range and endurance, load factor, turning flight, V-n diagram
Winds: head, tail and cross winds
longitudinal stick fixed and free stability
directional stability, vertical tail position and size
Linear momentum and angular momentum balance for rigid bodies
central force motion, Keplerian orbits, Kepler’s laws
decoupling of longitudinal and lateral-directional dynamics
Basic fluid mechanics: fluid kinematics, streamline, streakline, pathline
conservation laws: mass, linear momentum and energy (integral and differential form)
Hagen-Poiseulle flow, Couette flow, basic concepts in boundary layers, boundary layer thickness
sources, sinks, doublets, point vortex and their superposition, Bernoulli’s equation
aerodynamic coefficients: lift, drag and moment
thin airfoil theory, Kutta condition, starting vortex
finite wing theory: induced drag, Prandtl lifting line theory
critical and drag divergence Mach numbers
basic concepts of compressibility, one-dimensional compressible flows, isentropic flows, normal and oblique shocks, Prandtl-Meyer flow
pressure measurements using U-tube manometers and Pitot probe
Strength of materials: Stress and strain, stress-strain curves of steel and Aluminium
stresses and deflections in statically determinate and indeterminate linear elastic trusses, bars, beams, and shafts
two-dimensional transformations of stresses and strains, Mohr’s circle, principal stresses and strains
combined loading, failure criteria: maximum stress, Tresca, von Mises
torsion, bending and shear of open and closed thin-walled sections: symmetric and unsymmetric cross-sections
free and forced vibrations of undamped and damped SDOF systems
Equilibrium and compatibility equations in two-dimensional elasticity
Aerothermodynamics of aircraft engines: thrust, efficiency, range
Engine performance: ramjet, turbojet, turbofan, turboprop and turboshaft engines
Aerothermodynamics of non-rotating propulsion components such as intakes, nozzles
Axial compressors: angular momentum, work and compression, characteristic performance of a single axial compressor stage, efficiency of the compressor and degree of reaction, multi-staging
Centrifugal compressor: stage dynamics, inducer, impeller and diffuser
thrust equation and specific impulse, rocket performance
performance of solid and liquid propellant rockets
